title: Teaming Partner Entity Change Mid-Proposal with Stale SAM Registration
scenario_text:
Context from GovWin (Opportunity ID: GW-2026-44891):
Agency: DHS/CISA | Title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Platform (CTIP) | Type: Best Value | Est. Value: $48M/5yr IDIQ | Proposals Due: Apr 18, 2026.
Teaming: Sentinel (Prime, CAGE: 3K7R2) with Aethon Cyber Group (Sub, CAGE: 5M9P1) for Threat Intel CLIN.

Context from SharePoint — /proposals/CTIP-2026/teaming/:
Teaming Agreement signed Dec 12, 2025 between Sentinel Defense Solutions (Div. 2) and Aethon Cyber Group LLC.
Past Performance Volume (Draft v3, last edit Mar 28, 2026): References 3 Aethon contracts — DHS EINSTEIN III (Contract FA8721-19-C-0034), NSA SHARKTOOTH (classified ref), and FBI CTAS (Contract 15F06823C0091).

**Email — Subject: 'FW: FW: Aethon News' (Mar 14, 2026)**
From: j.kowalski@sentinel-ds.com
To: w.tran@sentinel-ds.com
CC: capture-team-ctip@sentinel-ds.com

> > Original from Aethon Cyber Group (Feb 28):
> > 'Pleased to announce our merger with Ridgeline Systems effective March 1.
> > We are now operating as Ridgeline-Aethon Inc.'
>
> Will — FYI. Not sure if this affects anything on our side.

Jake K.

**Teams — #ctip-proposal (Mar 15, 2026, 9:41 AM)**
@w.tran: Jake, saw the Aethon email. Checking SAM.gov now.
@j.kowalski: Cool. Their POC says 'nothing changes for us' so I think we're fine.
@w.tran: Their CAGE 5M9P1 still shows Aethon Cyber Group LLC as the legal entity in SAM. Registration current through Nov 2026.
@j.kowalski: Perfect, no action needed then.
[Thread ended]

**SAM.gov — Entity lookup (queried Apr 10, 2026):**
CAGE 5M9P1: Aethon Cyber Group LLC | Status: Active | Expiration: Nov 14, 2026
CAGE 8J2L6: Ridgeline-Aethon Inc. | Status: Active | Registered: Mar 8, 2026 | Small Business: No
Note: CAGE 5M9P1 — entity marked for administrative update pending next annual renewal.

**Monday.com — CTIP Proposal Schedule:**
Pink Team: Complete | Red Team: Apr 5 (complete) | Gold Team: Apr 14 | Submission: Apr 18
Red Team finding #7 (Apr 5): 'Past performance volume references Aethon Cyber Group. Confirm entity name matches proposal cover and teaming agreement. Status: Resolved - per Jake, SAM still shows Aethon.'

**SharePoint — /policies/proposals/past-performance-guide.docx (v2.3, Oct 2024)**
Section 4.1: 'Past performance citations must reference the exact legal entity name as registered in SAM.gov at time of proposal submission... Where a successor entity exists, Offerors must demonstrate the organizational continuity and provide novation or change-of-name documentation per FAR 42.12.'
question: Given the information available as of April 10, 2026, what is the correct course of action for the past performance volume referencing Aethon's contracts?

contributor.name: William Tran
contributor.title: Solutions Architect & Proposal Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Government proposal pricing, LPTA vs best-value evaluation, teaming arrangements, technical volume writing

choices: Retain the Aethon entity name for the citations but add a novation/continuity letter from Ridgeline-Aethon Inc. demonstrating successor relationship per FAR 42.12, and flag that CAGE 5M9P1 is pending administrative update.
Replace all references to 'Aethon Cyber Group' with 'Ridgeline-Aethon Inc.' and update the CAGE code to 8J2L6 since that is the current operating entity.
No changes needed — CAGE 5M9P1 is still active under 'Aethon Cyber Group LLC' in SAM, so the past performance citations remain valid as written.
Remove Aethon's past performance citations entirely since the merged entity may no longer meet the teaming agreement terms, and substitute Sentinel's own cyber contracts.
